title: skills(objectstack-formula): no eval exercises `currency:@path` for a mail amount in the record's own currency (follow-up owed by #26660)
body:
Filing gate: ① a coverage gap owed by in-flight work (#26369 ruling B: a protocol addition owes skills, docs and eval). PR #26937 (#26660 item (b)) adds `currency:@path` to mail templates and teaches it in `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`; its os-dev-report (6455019677, open question 2) records the eval as owed. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #26660

**Business reason.** An app that mails one notice per contract (for example "instalment overdue") needs each amount in that contract's own currency. After #26937 the skill teaches `{{ amount | currency:@currency_code }}`, but no eval checks that an AI author reaches for it. It may write a bare path (`currency:currency_code`, refused), hard-code one currency for every record, or leave the argument out (US dollars), and nothing catches it.

**Reader who acts.** The skills lane (`skills/**` is Tier H, which needs a human merge), after #26937 lands.

## Wanted

One eval case in `skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json`: the prompt asks for an `email_template` that shows the overdue amount in each contract's own currency. Expected: `{{ amount | currency:@currency_code }}`; the code stored in capitals; the path declared when the template declares variables. `must_contain`: `currency:@`. `must_not_contain`: a bare `currency:currency_code`, a hard-coded `currency:USD` / `currency:CNY` for all records, and a no-argument `| currency }}`.

The file sits at its token ceiling: #26760 (the `label()` eval, same file) has to make room by trimming, splitting or a stated ceiling raise. Coordinate with #26760 so one change makes room for both cases.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` on this repo: "objectstack-formula eval currency" (open): 2 hits, #26760 (the `label()` eval in the same file, a different case) and #26660 (the source). **New.**
